# PDF fixtures

Repository-owned synthetic documents, generated by `scripts/generate-pdf-fixtures.py` at the repository root with ReportLab, pypdf and Pillow. Tests consume these committed files without Python or a renderer.

- `pages.pdf`: physical pages 1/4/5 have English/Chinese text, page 2 is blank, page 3 contains image-only text. PDF PageLabels are i/ii/1/2/3. Page 4 exercises long-page splitting; page 5 is rotated. STSong-Light uses bundled Adobe CMaps without an embedded ToUnicode table.
- `scan.pdf`: only the image page, with no text layer.
- `password.pdf`: a locked copy of page 1 (test password `fixture-password`); the reader must skip it without prompting or guessing passwords.
- `damaged.pdf`: a broken page tree; other documents must still index.

Page citations are physical, one-based PDF positions. PageLabels are optional metadata and need not match printed text. Empty extraction does not distinguish a blank page from content requiring OCR.
